baslik: Why a Tiny Gas Leak Levels a Building
aciklama:
A gas leak you can barely smell can flatten an entire building. Here is the deadly chemistry.

#shorts #science #safety #explosion #howitworks

sahneler.metin: A leak you can barely smell can level a whole building.
Natural gas is invisible, so a smell is added to warn you.
A slow leak fills a room with an explosive mix of gas and air.
At the right concentration, it just needs one tiny spark.
A doorbell, a fridge, or a light switch is more than enough.
The whole room ignites at once in a pressure blast.
The shockwave blows out walls before the flames even spread.
That is why you never flip a switch if you smell gas.
You open windows, get out, and call from outside.
